spanish: No te postrarás a sus dioses, y no se te hará servirlos, y no harás conforme a sus obras, porque destruyendo los destruirás, y quebrando quebrarás sus estelas.
grammarChanges: h02023024005 (תָֽעָבְדֵ֔ם) is Hophal imperfect 2ms with 3mp suffix, a causative-passive form ('be made to serve them'), not an active form; replaced the active 'y no los servirás' with the causative-passive 'y no se te hará servirlos' to carry that stem force, keeping the same participants (the addressee; 'los' = their gods) and avoiding leísmo.
readerNote: Chose the causative-passive construction 'no se te hará servirlos' over an active rendering so the Spanish verb matches the Hophal stem rather than qal.
